chunks.text: Hello! I am your American Family Digital Coverage Advisor. I can help you understand your auto and home coverages, deductibles, limits, and bundling discounts. How can I assist you today?

userInput.text: What is the difference between AOP and Wind/Hail deductibles?

chunks.text: The All-Perils (AOP) deductible is the standard flat amount ($500 to $5,000) you pay out of pocket before insurance covers most claims. In many states, a separate Wind/Hail deductible applies specifically to wind or hail damage, often calculated as a percentage of your Dwelling coverage (e.g., 1% or 2%) and must be at least equal to your AOP deductible.
